title: 第14章 鹤影云栖茶中劫第15章 鹤隐茶香局中局
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、竹亭鹤影·茶烟弄清
大胤南疆「忘忧谷」深处，青竹掩映间露出一角琉璃瓦亭。
亭中石桌上摆着一套「冰纹翡翠茶具」，沸水在「八卦温壶」中翻滚，水面浮着三枚晶莹剔透的「太昊玄冰」——此冰取自青冥墟极北之地，三百年方得一寸，遇热不散，可保茶汤七泡仍冽。
人物登场：
白衣男子负手立于亭外，广袖绣着展翅仙鹤，腰悬玉牌刻「云栖鹤隐」四字。
他转身落座，指尖轻叩石桌，竟有三只白鹤衔着茶罐飞来，罐身分别标着「劫前春」「忘忧露」「醒世汤」。
男子取下「劫前春」茶罐，揭开时茶香四溢，隐约混着松烟与雪水的清冽。
泡茶三式：
1.鹤舞晾盏：
白鹤振翅扇动温壶，翡翠茶盏依次旋转，盏底映出「太昊扶桑」暗纹；
2.玄冰点春：
男子以玉筷夹起玄冰投入空盏，再撒入茶叶，沸水浇下时，冰纹与茶芽共舞，形成「劫后重生」的茶汤纹路；
3.云栖分茶：
茶汤分斟七盏，每盏表面都浮着一只由茶沫凝成的白鹤，他举杯轻吹，鹤影竟振翅飞向亭外竹林。
诗号：
「鹤舞云栖品劫茶，是非对错任人嗟。
莫道杯中天地小，乾坤尽在一瓯渣。
二、茶中玄机·正邪难辨
视觉细节：
-男子左手无名指戴着一枚青铜戒指，戒面刻着太昊氏「生死簿」残纹，却被磨去了「死」字；

-泡茶时，袖口滑落半幅画卷，隐约可见中天棋盘「悟」字位的坐标；
-三只白鹤非灵禽，而是机关所化，羽翼开合间传出齿轮轻响。
正邪之辨：
-正之表象：
茶名「忘忧」「醒世」暗含渡世之心，分茶时先敬天地，再敬空盏，尽显君子之风；
谈及劫外之乱时，他指尖轻点茶汤：「恐惧如茶渣，需沉淀方知真味。
-邪之暗流：
机关鹤的眼睛是劫外符文所铸，茶罐「劫前春」的封口蜡印有楚轩行的「权」字残章；
提起太昊玄渊时，嘴角勾起似笑非笑的弧度：「囚笼崩解，未必不是另一种禁锢。
三、鹤隐论劫·正道波生
对谈片段：
-沈墨卿（儒门）：「阁下茶中「劫前春」，可是取自劫界初开时的灵芽？」
云栖鹤隐轻晃茶盏：「太学主可知，灵芽需经劫火淬炼，方得此香？」
-萧素雪（道家）：「机关鹤的制法……与听潮阁有何渊源？」
他抚过鹤翼齿轮：「百里无霜小友倒是聪慧，不过吾这「劫外机关术」，比她多了三分……道心。
content_en:
1. Clarify the shadows of cranes in the bamboo pavilion and tea smoke
Deep in the "Wangyou Valley" in the southern border of Dayin, a corner of the glazed tile pavilion is exposed among the green bamboos.
An "Ice Pattern Jade Tea Set" is placed on the stone table in the pavilion. The boiling water is rolling in the "Bagua Warming Kettle". Three crystal clear "Taihao Xuan Ice" floats on the water surface - this ice is taken from the far north of Qingming Ruins. It takes three hundred years to get an inch. It will not dissipate when exposed to heat, and can keep the tea soup still cold after seven brews.
Characters appear:
A man in white clothes stands outside the pavilion with his hands behind his back, his wide sleeves are embroidered with a spreading crane, and a jade plaque hanging from his waist is engraved with the four characters "Yun Qi He Yin".
He turned around and sat down, tapping the stone table with his fingertips, and unexpectedly three white cranes flew over with tea cans in their mouths. The cans were marked "Jie Qian Chun", "Wangyou Dew" and "Awakening World Soup" respectively.
The man took off the "Jie Qian Chun" tea can, and when he opened it, the aroma of tea overflowed, vaguely mixed with the clear scent of pine smoke and snow water.
Three ways to make tea:
1. Crane dance and hanging lamp:
The white crane flaps its wings and flaps the warm pot, and the emerald tea cup rotates in turn, with the dark pattern of "Taihao Fusang" reflected on the bottom of the cup;
2. Xuan Bing Dian Chun:
The man picks up the black ice with jade chopsticks and puts it into the empty cup, and then sprinkles the tea leaves. When the boiling water is poured down, the ice patterns dance with the tea buds, forming the pattern of the tea soup that is "rebirth after disaster";
3. Yunqi tea:
The tea soup was poured into seven cups, with a white crane made of tea foam floating on the surface of each cup. He raised the cup and blew lightly, and the crane's shadow actually fluttered its wings and flew to the bamboo forest outside the pavilion.
Poetry number:
"Cranes dance in the clouds and drink tea from robbery, right or wrong is left to anyone to complain.
Mo Dao: The world in the cup is small, and the whole world is just one cup of dregs.
2. The mystery of tea·It is difficult to distinguish between good and evil
Visual details:
-The man wears a bronze ring on his left ring finger. The surface of the ring is engraved with the residual pattern of Taihao's "Book of Life and Death", but the word "death" has been rubbed away;
-While making tea, half of the picture scroll slipped off the sleeves, and the coordinates of the character "Enlightenment" on the Zhongtian chessboard were faintly visible;
-The three white cranes are not spiritual birds, but transformed into organs. There is a soft sound of gears when the wings are opening and closing.
The distinction between good and evil:
-The appearance of righteousness:
The name of the tea "Wangyou" and "Awakening the World" imply the desire to transcend the world. When dividing the tea, first respect the heaven and the earth, and then the empty cup, showing the style of a gentleman;
When talking about the chaos outside the Tribulation, he tapped the tea soup with his fingertips: "Fear is like tea leaves, it needs to settle before you can know the true taste.
-The undercurrent of evil:
The eyes of the machine crane are made of runes outside the robbery, and the sealing wax of the tea can "Spring Before the Tribulation" is stamped with the fragment of the character "quan" written by Chu Xuanxing;
When he mentioned Taihao Xuanyuan, the corner of his mouth curved into a smile that was not a smile: "The collapse of the cage may not be another kind of imprisonment.
3. He Yin discusses the calamity and the waves of the right path arise
Conversation excerpts:
-Shen Moqing (Confucianism): "The "Spring Before Tribulation" in your tea is taken from the spiritual buds when the Tribulation Realm first opened? "
Yunqi Heyin gently shook the tea cup: "Does Master Taixue know that spiritual buds need to be tempered by calamity fire to obtain this fragrance?"
-Xiao Suxue (Taoist): "What is the connection between the method of making the machine crane... and Tingchao Pavilion?"
He stroked the crane wing gear and said, "Little friend Baili Wushuang is quite smart, but my "Tribulation External Mechanism Technique" is three points more... Taoist than hers.
